notes.title: Website, FanClub + 5K Wishlist Celebration!
notes.content:
Website


GrowaGirlfriend.com has launched!

After spending the last 2 months working with @wSmileFlowerw, the Grow a Girlfriend website is live!

It has pictures, info, contact and a presskit, but the main reason I wanted it was for…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/bc32720c439a16e51c92e2e37f7c59a9e8470c15.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/b7b1e2e77af74af97e61c70c7df87df6e2018d9c.png"]


The Fanclub


Join the new FANCLUB on the site!

I have always wished to host a free newsletter of art, funny facts, FAQs and more exclusive content leading up to the release of my game.

Each of the girls will be sending you a special email. Button is first, and is sending hers this coming Friday 12th September, so make sure to sign up by then!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/ec0fd282ede92b06c961bc387a9d050915706f91.png"]


Wishlists


We hit 5000 Wishlists on Steam today!

Thank you so much, everyone! Once we hit 7000, Grow a Girlfriend will release! That may be around November at this rate. You can look forward to more demo translations and fanart on my social media and the special content just in the newsletter in the meantime.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/c2c7920da4cf90244d0875f34fefd51ef053148f.png"]

For professional, personal, or any questions, feel free to email me at trubluis@growagirlfriend.com

notes.title: French, Spanish, Russian and Lithuanian Translations Available
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/be3482427e23e534ab3396df16f848fcc7db64dc.png"]
On the main menu, there is now a button that allows you to play the demo in a different language (Currently: French, Spanish, Russian and Lithuanian).

These translations were only possible because of the graciousness of the volunteers! I enjoyed working with them to make the translations as good as they can be. Their names are mentioned in the new credits menu.


Report translation bugs!
It is impossible for me to playtest and proofread every translation fully. There is bound to be a typo, a strange sentence, or even a crash that has slipped my attention! If that happens, please email me. I am on hot-fix duty and will resolve any issues ASAP so that each game build is an improvement for the next player.

I am not native in these languages, so if anything seems odd, please be like Button below and make sure no bugs roam free! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/7a2a69702f5dec284660708f9a93fe07d1f0e072.png"]Entomologists will note that ladybugs are actually beetles, not bugs! Too bad I didn't consider that until after I drew this.

notes.title: Volunteer Translation Initiative!
notes.content:
Demo Translations now open
Several fans contacted me, asking if they could translate the game, so I've made all the necessary files publicly available in case there is anyone else who would like to volunteer!



Whether you work alone or as a team, I appreciate all the time and effort it takes to translate a game, so if you finish it, your names will be added to the credits and your translation added to the game's main menu!



The instructions and the necessary files are stored on a GitHub repo linked here.



Good luck! If you have any questions, you can always email me at true.blue.eyes@icloud.com


Thank You!


Finally, I am honoured by the level of support I have received since the demo's official launch! Thank you to those who sent fanmail, commented, reviewed or donated. Hearing that this work has touched so many hearts, and that there are people out there who want to help, means so much to me.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/e093a017c2bdf487a77cec92b68ff9e67660adad.png"]

notes.title: Welcome to Grow a Girlfriend!
notes.content:
Welcome to Grow a Girlfriend!
Greetings to all new players, and welcome back returning players from GaG's first release two years prior!

Thank you to everyone who has checked out, played and/or wishlisted the game. After working on it for so long, it is so gratifying to see the Steam page finally live. I hope its message and themes resonate with many players, and help those who find themselves with similar thoughts know that they're not as strange as they may think.


Feedback
I welcome comments, reviews, discussions, fanart etc.

Critique on the demo is very valuable. It will help me know what I need to work on in the next few months before the game's full release.

Oh, and let me know if it made you cry to make me feel extra happy. 


Full Game Release Date
The game is scheduled to release in quarter 4 of 2025, so if you haven't already, kindly wishlist it! That's the best way to support its development right now.


How this game was made
To see how I made this game, consider joining my Patreon. Many posts are freely available, while other posts with early design sketches and secret preview builds not shown in the demo are only for paid members.


To contact me directly
Whether it's to report a bug or to make a general query, business or casual, anyone is welcome to get in touch with me at true.blue.eyes@icloud.com.
